title: Ohm Boy Apple Elderflower & Garden Mint 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Apple Elderflower & Garden Mint by Ohm Boy is a refreshing blend that combines the crispness of Apples, the fragrant notes of Elderflower, and the cooling touch of Garden Mint. Each inhale delivers the invigorating taste of freshly picked Apples, followed by the delicate floral undertones of Elderflower. This unique combination of flavours creates a harmonious balance that is both satisfying and refreshing, making Apple Elderflower & Garden Mint a perfect choice for those looking for a refreshing and revitalizing vaping experience. Shortfill bottles from Ohm Boy E-liquids provide the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in Shortfills. Ohm Boy has emerged as one of the most innovative e-liquid manufacturers in the UK, thanks to flavours that refine and push the boundaries of e-juices into delicious new territory. Their range covers a wide spectrum of fruit and beverage blends, always with a unique take on flavours with captivating and complex characteristics.
